sol-3-1.summary: rebuildRecord and extractPassthrough retain prohibited Object.defineProperty calls despite the reported green native-runtime gate.
sol-3-1.fix: Build both records with R.fromEntries. Map R.toEntries(source) in rebuildRecord; filter R.keys(source) against consumed before reading retained values in extractPassthrough. Preserve enumeration/read order, own __proto__/constructor data keys, and the ordinary output prototype. Add public-path hostile-key and consumed-getter regressions in ResolvedTsconfig.test.ts; keep existing assertions. Deviation bookkeeping is centrally owned.

fable-3-1.summary: S.toType strips preserved CompilerOptions field codecs, causing the portable document decoder to reject supported uppercase spellings instead of normalizing them.
fable-3-1.fix: Remove only the outer S.toType around PortableCompilerOptions, retaining picked codecs, identity annotations, optional types, literal forced flags, and excess-key stripping. Add mixed/uppercase enum and lib decode regressions with canonical output/encoding assertions in PortableTsconfig.test.ts. Preserve existing invalid-option, forced-flag, and path-stripping assertions and keep make as the upstream CompilerOptions.Type projection.
